back: The circumcision of a baby boy on the eighth day, the sign of the covenant with Abraham (Genesis 17).
Ceremonies when a boy (13) or girl (12 or 13) takes on responsibility for the commandments.
The Jewish marriage contract, signed by witnesses and read at the wedding.
The home the couple will build together.

front: Why is a glass broken at a wedding?
back: To remember the destruction of the Temple even in a time of joy.
Shiva: seven days of mourning. Sheloshim: thirty days. Yahrzeit: the yearly anniversary of a death.
A prayer praising God, said by mourners; it does not mention death.

front: Why is burial usually soon and simple?
back: Respect for the dead and equality: rich and poor are treated alike.
